name: Parametric Texturing with Lightmap and Reference Map
definition: A texturing scheme for voxel landscapes that uses a single shader script for the whole landscape but stores varying parameters in arrays to avoid the memory overhead of per-voxel textures (which would exceed 1 GB for a 1024x1024 map) while minimizing visible tiling.
summary: Parametric Texturing with Lightmap and Reference Map is a voxel landscape texturing scheme that uses a single shader and two maps to avoid per-voxel memory overhead and achieve extreme inner-loop speed.
